up: Retrieve all exact IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested against the human protein target 'Histone deacetylase 1' (CHEMBL325). For each activity, return the following columns: the compound's ChEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id), the canonical SMILES of the compound, the exact IC50 value (standard_value in nM), and the provenance of the assay (prefer PubMed ID, otherwise DOI). Ensure the target organism is human. Do not apply any confidence score filters. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL325'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
